title: Sharpen the deferred signed bit moment: conditional kappa 6.3974824e-5
body:
## Summary

Dependent follow-up to #97 at `f5f9c56e637463cac1e300d1589ccf42838f688a`. On its **unchanged** bit histogram and complex network, two independent exact rational enclosures certify the actual bit moment at
`a=63983013240044/10^18` (the adjacent `10^-18` point is rejected).
Substituting only that bit saving into #97's frozen balanced assembly gives
conditional `κ=63974824/10^12 = 6.3974824e-5`, up from #97's
`63965813/10^12`: a gain of `9011/10^12`. All 47 strict constraints and
seven cost margins are checked; the next `10^-12` κ grid point fails the
binding compact-phase-layer margin.

This is an analytic improvement on the *same physical construction*, not a
new network, changed recursion, or unconditional multiplication theorem.
It inherits #97's physical proof and the repository's retained
analytic/fixed-tape interfaces. It does not claim a globally best κ.

The stack also removes four #97 `SOURCE.json` references to `*.log` files
that are absent from the Git tree and ignored by `.gitignore`. No committed
source pin is relaxed. Without this correction,
`make deferred-signed-verify` fails before checking #97; with it, the
original verifier passes.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 research/round7-moment-followup/check_sources.py
python3 research/round7-moment-followup/verify.py
python3 research/round7-moment-followup/independent_moment.py \
  --case accepted=exp:accept:63983013240044/1000000000000000000 \
  --case adjacent=exp:reject:63983013240045/1000000000000000000 \
  --output /tmp/croc-round7-independent-FRESH.json
make deferred-signed-verify
```

The two committed JSON certificates preserve exact endpoints and the full
assembly result. The independent method uses a different logarithm reduction
and Taylor degree. The unchanged #97 verifier passed locally after the
manifest correction. I did not rerun the full repository-wide `make verify`.

## Credit and scope

Swapnil Jain supplied the pinned round-seven bit histogram. Zhihao Chen's
#97 supplies the deferred/signed endpoints and CrocSwap assembly integration.
The sharper moment enclosure was developed in SovereignSteak's companion
[PR #2](https://github.com/Swapnil-jain/integer-mult-kappa/pull/2);
this PR certifies its effect under **CrocSwap's distinct assembly**, without
copying the companion's final κ. Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance.
